entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand tracker. I've had it, and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
The issue is I don't want it! That's the issue. I'm not going through a whole interrogation. Just process the refund. My order number is 88C-1452.
Okay, thank you. Let me pull up that order... 88C-1452. Okay, I see the order here. Sir, our return policy on wearable devices is quite strict for hygiene reasons.
What does that mean? Are you trying to get out of this? I knew it. This company is a scam. I want to speak to a manager!
Sir, I understand your frustration, but once a device like this has been worn, there are sanitation concerns. The policy is in place to protect all our customers.
Sanitation? Are you kidding me? This is unbelievable! I'm going to light you up on social media. It's not too late for me to post reviews everywhere telling people what a joke this policy is!
Sir, please allow me to just double-check the specifics for your exact product... one moment... Ah. Okay, I see what's happened. My sincerest apologies, I was referencing the wrong policy.
What? So you were just trying to deny my return?

Not at all, it was a genuine mistake. Your VeloBand GPS Tracker actually falls under our standard 90-day return policy. I see it was delivered just 8 days ago, so you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. I can approve this return for you right now.
Oh. Well, that's what you should have said in the first place. Fine. So what do I do?

I have just authorized the return. I am emailing you a pre-paid shipping label as we speak. You'll just need to print that out, affix it to the original packaging, and drop it at your local post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Okay. Good. That's all I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome, and again, my apologies for the initial confusion. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
